proposal.root_cause: Model fails to handle DISTINCT for join-induced duplicates and misinterprets 'Which [Entity]' questions as selecting only the ID/Name instead of all columns (SELECT *)
proposal.what: Update system prompt to explicitly instruct using DISTINCT when joining one-to-many tables or selecting single attributes to avoid duplicate rows, and to use SELECT * when the question asks for details/information about an entity rather than a specific column. This addresses sp0600 (missing DISTINCT) and sp0755 (wrong projection).
